For my chelli

Some people enter our lives quietly… and somehow become a part of who we are.

You are one of those people for me.

I don’t know exactly when our bond became this special. I don’t even know how to explain what you mean to me in a few words. I just know that somewhere between all the silly talks, random fights, laughter, memories, and those little moments we never thought would matter… you became family.

You are not just someone I know.
You are someone whose presence changed a part of me.

There may be days when we annoy each other, misunderstand each other, or don’t talk properly. But none of that can change the place you have in my heart.

And if you ever wonder how special you are to me, remember this:

I may meet hundreds of people in my life, but there will always be only one you.

Thank you for being a part of my life, for giving me memories I’ll always carry, and for simply being yourself.

No birthday.
No special occasion.
No reason.

I just wanted you to know…

You are loved. You are valued. You are irreplaceable. And you will always have a special place in my life. ❤️🫂

No birthday. No occasion. Just wanted you to know. 🤍
